stages.title: Sunset Overpass
stages.opening_cutscene: Roadblock ahead. Those cages are moving. Iron Veil is worse than a roadblock.
stages.ending_cutscene: Brask escapes by helicopter platform. The rescued beacon points toward the jungle lab.

stages.title: Glassleaf Jungle
stages.opening_cutscene: The beacon leads into a glowing research district. Something is forcing panic into the wildlife.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Glassback is freed from the control collar. Its trail leads to Ember Rest.

stages.title: Ember Rest Market
stages.opening_cutscene: Ember Rest should be safe, but Iron Veil has already slipped into the market.
stages.ending_cutscene: Sable Rin vanishes through the rooftops, leaving a rail manifest behind.

stages.title: Mineral Rail
stages.opening_cutscene: The crew boards a cargo train carrying Deep Crown drill parts.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Rail Maw tears loose and falls into the canyon. The next stop is Ashforge.

stages.title: Ashforge Town
stages.opening_cutscene: Tor knows this place. He helped guard it before he changed sides.
stages.ending_cutscene: Vorrak's exo-frame breaks. The mobile lab is fleeing across the storm plain.

stages.title: Storm Plain Chase
stages.opening_cutscene: Purple lightning breaks over the badlands as the Sundrifter catches Klade's lab.
stages.ending_cutscene: Klade's control tower explodes. A tunnel opens into the Underroot.

stages.title: The Underroot
stages.opening_cutscene: The living root network hums under the continent. Loud fights wake dangerous nests.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Echo Queen backs away from her nest as the mutation crystals go dark.

stages.title: Deep Crown Citadel
stages.opening_cutscene: Mara Voss activates the Deep Crown. The rift starts to collapse.
stages.ending_cutscene: The Deep Crown shuts down without killing the rift. Dawn reaches the open road.

final_ending: Kian says the rift is stabilizing. Nika says healing can go faster. Tor smiles. Raya listens to the engine and says the road's open.
